title: _do_repair re-fetches the asset via find_asset when repair_asset already returns it
detail: repair_asset already returns the repaired asset in result["asset"], identical to upgrade_asset. The added find_asset call re-queries state unnecessarily and diverges from the sibling pattern ten lines above.
recommended_fix: Drop the find_asset line; use the returned asset: var asset: Dictionary = result["asset"], then _record("repair", {"name": asset["name"]}).
